unitStats.title: Unit stats
unitStats.description: Each side has one of each unit. Values below are for standard mode.
unitStats.timing: Each strategy Tick is {{tick}} seconds. Attacks resolve simultaneously using positions at the start of the Tick.
unitStats.archerTiming: An archer can shoot only if its target is already in range at Tick start and its cooldown has ended. Shooting locks the current and next Tick (0.5 seconds); the full attack cooldown is 1 second.
unitStats.enhancementChoice: Each strategy selects one enhancement in its file. The choice is fixed at the start of a game.

guide.title: How to play
guide.description: Write rules for three units, then watch them fight, capture and defend automatically.

objective.title: Win conditions
objective.text: Bring the enemy flag within 1 cell of your own flag base to win, even if your own flag is away. You also win when all three enemy units are permanently eliminated.
objective.detail: A match lasts at most 8 minutes of game time. Timeout or both sides winning in the same Tick produces a draw. Units waiting to respawn do not count as permanently eliminated.

battlefield.title: Battlefield and movement
battlefield.text: The battlefield is a 100 × 50 open plane with a red base on the left and a blue base on the right. Each side has one heavy infantry, cavalry and archer.
battlefield.detail: Units move in continuous coordinates without collision or blocking. Diagonal movement is no faster. Strategies can also specify a fixed destination within the battlefield.

capture.title: Capture and carry
capture.text: To take an enemy flag that is at home, issue CAPTURE_ENEMY_FLAG within 1 cell of its base and remain there for 3 continuous seconds without moving or attacking. Leaving, dying or losing access to the flag resets progress.
capture.detail: Each unit can carry one flag. Carrying either flag reduces speed by 25%. Carriers can attack, with normal archer restrictions. Bringing an enemy flag home wins automatically; bringing your own flag home does not.

flags.title: Dropped flags
flags.text: A carrier drops its flag on death. Merely touching a flag never picks it up or returns it; your strategy must issue a special action.
flags.detail: Picking up or returning a flag requires being within 1 cell. Taking an enemy flag from its home requires 3 continuous seconds of capture.

combat.title: Combat timing
combat.text: Only enemies can be attacked. Attacks in range with a ready cooldown always deal damage, without random misses or critical hits. Heavy infantry and cavalry can move while attacking.
combat.detail: All units decide from the same Tick-start snapshot. Attacks resolve together first, deaths stop further actions, then surviving units move. Archers cannot move and shoot in one Tick; see Unit stats for shooting locks and enhancements.

respawn.title: Death and respawn
respawn.text: Each unit tracks its own deaths: the first three respawns take 5, 10 and 20 seconds. The fourth death permanently eliminates that unit.
respawn.detail: Spawn and respawn locations are chosen inside the home base, more than 2 cells from its flag base, and are reproducible with the match seed. Respawning restores full health. Strategies cannot choose spawn coordinates.

strategy.title: Create and trial a strategy
strategy.text: Give each unit a rule list. Higher priorities are checked first; the first matching rule supplies movement, attack and special actions. Both sides can read current global positions, health, flags and recent activity, but not opposing rule files or future actions.
strategy.detail: Download the AI rule kit for your external creation tool, then import and save its strategy file here. Step advances the game by 0.25 seconds. Decisions and events help explain the result; local trials do not affect rankings.

arena.title: Official arena and ranking
arena.text: Each member may enter one saved version. Confirming entry publishes its full source to this world; withdrawing or archiving does not revoke that source. World owners and admins start batches, freezing all entries.
arena.detail: Up to 48 members play pairwise single matches, using seed 12027 and fixed red/blue assignments. The server computes official results. Completed batches publish Glicko-2 rankings by Rating − 2 × RD; fewer than 10 matches is provisional. New edits apply to future batches.
